note: Adapted from Light & Wilson 1936, original in English (The nasute termites of the Philippines, The Philippine Journal of Science 60: 461–520). Both the alate and the worker are given as Unknown in the original; type collection No. 1183, Cotabato Province, Mindanao, this single lot only. The authors note that the colour varies from dark opaque chestnut in large individuals to yellowish-tinged pale brown in some small individuals; the range of variation in the width and shape of the head in dorsal view, the lateral outline and the nasus shape is shown in Fig. 11 a—d. Fig. 11 (heads of two soldiers from the same nest in dorsal view, heads of two further soldiers in lateral view, soldier left mandible) not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closest to Eutermes (E.) javanicus Holmgren, differing in the distinctly larger size and darker colour. Soldier nasus peak projecting, slightly constricted at the base; front of the head markedly narrowed; antennal sockets not visible in dorsal view; head with 3—4 distinct hairs.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body very pale yellowish brown; the membranous areas on the sides transparent white; antennae pale brown; the rest pale yellow. Head and nasus shape as in Fig. 11 a—d. Nasus peak projecting, slightly constricted at the base; front of the head markedly narrowed; antennal sockets not visible in dorsal view; head with 3—4 distinct hairs. Antennae 13-segmented, slightly shorter than head plus nasus; segment 3 much longer than segment 2; segment 4 and segment 1 about as long as segment 2 and not always completely separated. Abdomen relatively long and slender, not humped. Measurements (mm and indices, from type collection No. 1183, soldiers from Cotabato Province, Mindanao): head plus nasus 1.47, 1.39, 1.53; head length (excluding nasus) 1.02, 0.91, 0.99; nasus length 0.45, 0.48, 0.54; head projection 0.39, 0.27, 0.35; head height 0.60, 0.60, 0.67; head width 0.90, 0.84, 0.99; fore tibia length 0.78; head index 0.88, 0.92, 1.00; head-nasus index 0.44, 0.53, 0.55; head projection index 0.29, 0.36, 0.33; leg extension index 0.77, 0.76, 0.79.
